library(gt) library(dplyr) illness |> head(10) |> slice(2:10) |> select(-units) |> gt(rowname_col = "test") |> cols_nanoplot( columns = c(starts_with("day"), norm_l, norm_u), new_col_name = "values", new_col_label = md("*Progression*"), missing_vals = "remove" ) |> tab_header(md("Partial summary of daily tests
performed on YF patient")) |> tab_stubhead(label = md("**Test**")) |> cols_align(align = "center", columns = values) |> tab_source_note(source_note = "Measurements from Day 3 through to Day 8.")

random_numbers_df <-
  tibble(
    i = 1:4,
    lines = c(
      "20 23 6 7 37 23 21 4 7 16",
      "2.3 6.8 9.2 2.42 3.5 12.1 5.3 3.6 7.2 3.74",
      "-12 -5 6 3.7 0 8 -7.4",
      "2 0 15 7 8 10 1 24 17 13 6"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(bars = lines)

random_numbers_df |>
  gt(rowname_col = "i") |>
  cols_nanoplot(columns = lines, new_col_name = "lines_plot", new_col_label = "lines", plot_type = "line") |>
  cols_nanoplot(columns = bars, new_col_name = "bars_plot", new_col_label = "bars", plot_type = "bar")

random_numbers_df |>
  gt(rowname_col = "i") |>
  cols_nanoplot(
    columns = lines,
    new_col_name = "lines_plot",
    new_col_label = "lines",
    reference_line = "mean",
    reference_area = c("min", "q1")
  ) |>
  cols_nanoplot(
    columns = bars,
    new_col_name = "bars_plot",
    new_col_label = "bars",
    plot_type = "bar",
    reference_line = "max",
    reference_area = c("max", "median")
  )

single_vals_df <-
  tibble(
    i = 1:5,
    bars = c(4.1, 1.3, -5.3, 0, 8.2),
    lines = c(12.44, 6.34, 5.2, -8.2, 9.23)
  )

single_vals_df |>
  gt(rowname_col = "i") |>
  cols_nanoplot(columns = bars, new_col_name = "bars_plot", new_col_label = "bars", plot_type = "bar") |>
  cols_nanoplot(columns = lines, new_col_name = "lines_plot", new_col_label = "lines", plot_type = "line")

random_numbers_df |>
  gt() |>
  cols_nanoplot(
    columns = lines,
    new_col_name = "lines_plot",
    new_col_label = "lines",
    options = nanoplot_options(
      data_point_radius = 8,
      data_point_stroke_color = "black",
      data_point_stroke_width = 3,
      data_point_fill_color = "white",
      data_line_type = "straight",
      data_line_stroke_color = "green",
      data_line_stroke_width = 5,
      data_area_fill_color = "green",
      show_data_area = FALSE
    )
  ) |>
  cols_nanoplot(
    columns = bars,
    new_col_name = "bars_plot",
    new_col_label = "bars",
    plot_type = "bar",
    options = nanoplot_options(
      data_bar_stroke_color = "brown",
      data_bar_fill_color = "yellow",
      data_bar_negative_stroke_color = "black",
      data_bar_negative_fill_color = "blue"
    )
  )
